settings.text: Everything you need to know before you order.

settings.question: What is OTO and how does it work?
settings.answer: OTO Men's Care products are natural health products formulated to support vitality, stamina and overall male wellbeing. Follow the directions on the pack for best results.

settings.question: Is it safe to use?
settings.answer: OTO products are intended for healthy adult men 18+. Always read the label, do not exceed the recommended use, and speak to a healthcare professional if you are unsure.

settings.question: Will my order be discreetly packaged?
settings.answer: Yes. Every order ships in plain packaging with no product branding on the outside, and your billing statement shows a neutral descriptor.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders are processed quickly and shipped discreetly. Delivery times depend on your location, and you will receive tracking as soon as your order ships.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships you will receive an email with a tracking link. If you have not received it, contact our support team.

settings.question: Why is it sold as a pack of 3?
settings.answer: Each box contains 4 tablets. The 3-pack gives you 12 tablets and a lower price per box than buying individually.

settings.question: Can I use this if I have a medical condition or take medication?
settings.answer: Please consult your doctor or pharmacist before use if you have a medical condition (including diabetes, heart or blood-pressure conditions) or take any medication.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We stand behind our products. If there is a problem with your order, contact our support team and we will make it right.

settings.heading: Your questions answered
settings.text: Can't find what you need? Contact us.
settings.help_text: Our support team is here to help.
